description: This PHP source file defines the abstract class LoggerFactory, which serves as a base for creating logger instances within the log4php logging framework. It includes a method makeNewLoggerInstance that is intended to be overridden in subclasses.

classes.name: LoggerFactory
classes.description: An abstract class providing a factory method for creating Logger objects within the log4php framework. The method makeNewLoggerInstance is meant to be overridden in subclasses to instantiate specific loggers.
